title: The Confoundedness of Success: Part 1
summary: The season-opening conversation on what success actually is — how the goalposts shift across a life, how cultural defaults (gender, religion, money, status) sneak into the definition, and how Kahran and Divya have moved from singular targets to multi-dimensional ones (artistic, business, personal, spiritual). They thread in agency, growth, joy and how childhood scripts shape what feels like winning.

intents.display: to question what success means and how the goalposts keep moving
